visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark, shoulder-length hair, bright red lipstick, and a colorful traditional red and gold qipao stands in the center of the frame. Her hands are pressed together in a greeting gesture. The background consists of dark wood lattice panels, red hanging scrolls, and red lanterns with tassels. (2) As she speaks, the woman uses expressive hand gestures, including points and open-palm movements. The camera remains static at eye level, capturing her from the chest up. (3) She holds up one finger to emphasize her first point, then later holds up two fingers for her second point. The lighting is consistent and bright, illuminating the studio setting clearly. (4) Red and gold graphics of traditional Chinese clouds and gold ingots are layered at the bottom of the screen. (5) The video concludes with a red graphic splash screen featuring a 3D cartoon snake holding a lantern, gold calligraphy, and a website URL.
